facts.fact: In 2019, less than one-tenth of combined US linear and connected TV ad spend was dedicated to CTV, according to EMARKETER as cited by StackAdapt.

facts.fact: CTV now accounts for one-third of combined US linear and connected TV ad spend.
facts.quote: Now, it accounts for one-third, and [EMARKETER predicts](https://content-na1.emarketer.com/ctv-growth-normalizes-subscriptions-ad-spend-evolves) CTV’s share of ad spend in the US will be nearly equal to linear TV advertising by 2028.
